# ShipKit

> ShipKit is a free, open-source (MIT) plugin for Claude Code that adds 24 skills and 2 git hooks. The skills review branches, fix bugs from the root cause, test the running app, audit QA and UX, guide refactoring, deploy to a VPS, add an MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT, improve SEO and write videos, demos and user guides. It works on any stack, on Windows, macOS and Linux.

ShipKit is for developers who use Claude Code. It is not a standalone app, a hosted service or a CI product; the skills run inside Claude Code.

Install inside Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add parvez-ahammed/shipkit
/plugin install shipkit@shipkit
```

Skills trigger on their own when a request matches their description, or run explicitly as `/shipkit:<skill>`. Three run only as commands: `/shipkit:deliver-issue`, `/shipkit:show-usage` and `/shipkit:fill-timesheet`.

## Docs

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit): source, issues and pull requests
- [README](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/README.md): install, skill list, requirements, FAQ
- [License (MIT)](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/LICENSE)
- [Website](https://parvez-ahammed.github.io/shipkit/)

## Review and fix

- [review-branch](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/review-branch/SKILL.md): multi-seat code review of a branch or PR with a refutation pass, a ranked punch list and an HTML report
- [fix-bug](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md): one bug end to end; root cause proven before any fix, with a regression test
- [build-story](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/build-story/SKILL.md): one user story or ticket from raw ask to verified, review-ready code
- [test-branch](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/test-branch/SKILL.md): tests a branch against the real running app and writes an HTML report with screenshots
- [grill-feature](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/grill-feature/SKILL.md): checks whether a shipped feature's promise holds in the code, with file:line evidence

## Plan and deliver

- [groom-issue](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/groom-issue/SKILL.md): scores a ticket's readiness against a rubric, finds gaps and undeclared blockers, and rewrites it into a buildable plan after you confirm; brief mode gives an executive brief of a milestone in build order
- [deliver-issue](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/deliver-issue/SKILL.md): delivers one issue or a whole milestone end to end: groom, plan, build, review, test, ship; pushing, PRs and merges wait for your yes
- [price-product](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/price-product/SKILL.md): pricing tiers, margin safety per tier, competitor prices with cited sources, value metric, and a check of every price surface for contradictions

## QA and UX

- [audit-app](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/audit-app/SKILL.md): QA release report and six-persona UX audit of a running web app
- [find-ux-gaps](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/find-ux-gaps/SKILL.md): parallel UX auditors whose findings become tickets, filed only after confirmation

## Refactor and architecture

- [refactor](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/refactor/SKILL.md): finds code smells, gives safe refactoring mechanics, and scores design patterns against your code
- [enforce-clean-architecture](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/enforce-clean-architecture/SKILL.md): Clean / Hexagonal architecture rulebook, bootstrap and layering guard
- [find-shared-code](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/find-shared-code/SKILL.md): finds what is worth sharing across a backlog, with DRY / KISS / YAGNI judgment
- [simplify-code](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/simplify-code/SKILL.md): removes over-engineering in one behavior-preserving change set: dead code, needless layers, reinvented helpers, verified by your own build and tests
- [trim-comments](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/trim-comments/SKILL.md): deletes comments that restate the code or narrate history and keeps the ones that explain a non-obvious why

## Ship and operate

- [deploy-to-vps](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/deploy-to-vps/SKILL.md): push-to-deploy CI/CD to a VPS with GitHub Actions, Caddy HTTPS, DNS, OAuth, hardening and honest health checks
- [add-mcp-server](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/add-mcp-server/SKILL.md): adds a read-only MCP server to an existing app so its owner can ask Claude or ChatGPT about their own data, with API keys and OAuth 2.1
- [boost-seo](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/boost-seo/SKILL.md): SEO and AEO audit and fixes, proven with local tests

## Create and document

- [make-video](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/make-video/SKILL.md): promo and explainer videos built from code, rendered to MP4
- [make-demo](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/make-demo/SKILL.md): pixel-exact clickable HTML demo captured from your running app
- [write-user-guide](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/write-user-guide/SKILL.md): end-user feature guide as HTML and PDF, checked against the code
- [write-plainly](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/write-plainly/SKILL.md): plain-English house style for commits, PRs, code comments and docs

## Insight

- [show-usage](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/show-usage/SKILL.md): active time, sessions, tokens and cost per project from local Claude Code transcripts
- [fill-timesheet](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/blob/master/plugins/shipkit/skills/fill-timesheet/SKILL.md): reconstructs past work as paste-ready timesheet rows

## Optional

- [secret-hygiene hook](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/tree/master/hooks/secret-hygiene): git hook that blocks a commit that adds a secret
- [safe-commit hook](https://github.com/parvez-ahammed/shipkit/tree/master/hooks/safe-commit): git commit-message validator
